restaurantName: Surf & Turf Restaurant at the Edinburgh Holyrood Hotel
bio: Housed inside the prestigious Edinburgh Holyrood Hotel, Surf & Turf Restaurant offers an indulgent Afternoon Tea feast in unforgettable surroundings.  The decor is as sumptuous as the food with a an elegantly muted palette of browns and greys. Varnished wood accents and soft leather banquettes add a comforting touch to the elegant design.  With uniquely sourced Scottish ingredients and fresh local produce, the food is a contemporary, slightly decadent vision of what fine dining should be.  Waverley Rail Station is just a seven-minute walk away.
pageTitle: Surf & Turf Restaurant at the Edinburgh Holyrood Hotel
